text.en:
Paragraph (c), subsection A of section one of Act Numbered Forty-one hundred and eighty,
otherwise known as the Public Works Act of nineteen hundred and thirty-five, is hereby amended so that item
15, under caption Palawan, shall read as follows:
"15. For the Balala Elementary School, Culion ..................... P1,000.00"

This Act shall take effect on the date of its approval.
Approved, August 10, 1935.
